<Summary>
Shot C, segment 1 of 3, of ONE continuous take inside the same vast ruined gothic castle great hall matching Picture 3. Low angle close-medium shot looking up at Jialing, the towering vaulted ceiling with shattered dome visible above. On the altar the brass lantern's flame gutters violently in a wind that moves nothing else. In the world, the carved stone altar stays fixed at the center of the hall, the massive broken stone pillar stays fixed on the right side of the hall with the row of flickering candelabras at its base. Throughout the entire shot the altar, the pillar and the candelabras never move; only Jialing, the candle flames and the camera move. Jialing wears the same black robe and carries the same brass lantern throughout. In the final stretch of this segment the camera settles into a perfectly still hold for the last two seconds. Scene and weather: Night inside the same vast ruined gothic castle great hall, the shattered dome opening to a clouded sky, a colossal faceless black figure pressing down and eclipsing the pale moon, candle flames guttering, then an extreme close on the brass lantern before the blinding white burst floods the frame. Color grade: chiaroscuro, extreme low-key, cold steel-blue, moonlit rim on her hair, abruptly overexposed to pure white by the light blast at the end, film grain.
